source: Reuel, Hardy, Smith, Lamparth, Hardy, Kochenderfer. BetterBench: Assessing AI Benchmarks, Uncovering Issues, and Establishing Best Practices. NeurIPS 2024 Datasets & Benchmarks (spotlight). arXiv:2411.12990
extracted: 2026-10-08 with pdftotext -layout; the two-column figures were de-interleaved by hand
aggregation: stage score = mean of its criteria; usability = weighted mean of implementation, documentation and maintenance; the paper reads a mean of 10 or more as reasonably good
count_note: The figures list 47 items (14 + 11 + 19 + 3) while the paper text says 46. All 47 are kept verbatim; which one the authors count differently is not stated in the source.

design: Tested capability, characteristic, or concept is defined
How tested capability or concept translates to benchmark task is described
Use cases or user personas are described
Differences to related benchmarks are explained
How benchmark score should or shouldn't be interpreted or used is described
How knowing about the tested concept is helpful in the real world is described
Metric floors and ceilings are included
implementation: Evaluation data or generation mechanism is accessible
Evaluation of models via API is supported
Evaluation of local models is supported
Globally unique identifier or encryption of evaluation instances is added
Task to identify if model has been trained on benchmark data is included
Script to replicate results is explicitly included
Statistical significance or uncertainty quantification of benchmark results is reported
Need for warnings for sensitive/harmful content is assessed
documentation: Requirements file available or equivalent is available
Quick-start guide or demo is available
Accompanying paper is accepted at peer-reviewed venue
Assumptions of normative properties are documented
Test environment design or prompt design process is documented
Globally unique, persistent identifier for a dataset and its metadata is provided
Data sources and data collection process are explained
Data preprocessing steps are described (if applicable)
Data annotation process is described (if applicable)
Data is documented using a standardized format.
maintenance: Code usability was checked within the last year
Maintained feedback channel for users is available
